summary: A pipeline turned course material into validated question and answer pairs, with abstention examples, and fine-tuned small bases with QLoRA on one card: Apertus-8B first, then Ministral-3-8B, a Ministral 14B and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B in later rounds, each evaluated on held-out abstention, over-refusal and knowledge sets. The chain worked end to end; adapters learned the answer voice and the abstention format, but knowledge did not improve reliably, and the later rounds were closed on material errors rather than exported. Recipe, training figures and aggregate scores per checkpoint only (data/forge/); the lab kept no full loss curve; no corpus, adapter or item is published.
title: Dataset factory, biology: from course material to a fine-tuned tutor
